Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Curved-Back Dining Chair, 35"H, Felt Gray
Colors: Felt Gray
Materials: Wood
The curved back and outside channel of this dining chair create an elegant touch to any room while providing comfortable support. Felt-gray fabric allows it to seamlessly fit into a number of decor schemes. The solid wood frame creates a sturdy dining seat. 24"W x 26"D x 35"H; seat height: 19"H; seat depth: 18"D; seat back height: 15"H 100% polyester fabric on solid wood frame Curved back with outside channel No assembly required Avoid moisture. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
